ads.headline: Tried everything? Try no metal.
ads.primary_text: Titanium. Surgical steel. Nickel free posts. The clear nail polish trick. If your ears still end up red and itchy by dinner, the answer might not be a better metal. Every Earrings by Emma post and hook is plastic, so there is no metal touching the ear. Hundreds of styles, family owned in Oklahoma.

ads.headline: Sensitive ears shouldn't cost gold.
ads.primary_text: Gold is one of the few metals many sensitive ears tolerate, and a pair of 14k studs can easily cost $50 to $200 or more. Emma's family learned that the hard way when she lost a gold pair swimming, and they didn't want to keep buying gold earrings. So they started making plastic post earrings instead. Faux Pearl Studs are $16, and you get a fourth pair free when you buy 3.
ads.why: The hidden cost of sensitive ears is paying gold prices for everyday earrings. The receipt makes the math visible and ties it to the true founding story.

ads.headline: Plastic? Yes. Cheap? No.
ads.primary_text: Our posts and hooks are polycarbonate, the same material used in safety goggles and motorcycle helmets. Strong, light, and no metal touching the ear. Family owned in Oklahoma, with most pairs assembled by hand, and every pair backed by a 2 year warranty.
ads.why: The biggest doubt about plastic posts is that they look and feel cheap. A spec sheet answers with her own facts, and a real customer says the rest.
